
## TikZ Gallery

This gallery presents a collection of **LaTeX TikZ graphics** designed for teaching, scientific communication, and engineering documentation.

The figures cover topics in:

- Electronics
- Electrical Engineering
- Sensors and Instrumentation
- Signal Processing
- Control Systems
- Embedded Systems
- Biomedical Engineering

## Categories

### Electronics

Schematics, electrical components, circuits, and electronic systems.

### Sensors & Instrumentation

Sensors, transmitters, measurement chains, signal conditioning, and industrial instrumentation.

### Signal Processing

Signal acquisition, filtering, sampling, and processing diagrams.

### Control Systems

Block diagrams, feedback systems, and automatic control structures.

### Embedded Systems

Microcontrollers, embedded architectures, communication buses, and IoT systems.

### Biomedical Engineering

Biomedical instrumentation, ECG systems, biosensors, and medical signal-processing diagrams.
